answer: Aggregate behaviour monitoring fingerprints each submission against the cohort: when pairwise divergence falls under the karst threshold, the identity's weight decays geometrically instead of being banned, so a ring's influence shrinks as it grows. Entry still costs a per-identity bond, a rate cap, and a trust delay; the grove sampler pulls audit subsets whose cipher must be unique per author, catching shared drafts. N fakes pay N bonds yet command decaying weight.
